headline: CRUCESMETRO Mircoles 4 de junio del 2024 No 474 ES ADECADO ABRIR UN ESPACIO COMO EL LUGAR DE LA MEMORIA EN LIMA?
content: RICARDO V SQUEZ KUNZE Abogado y analista político.. The first reflection that has to be made is that its going to be a controversial place because there isnt consensus about what history is being told there. If the purpose of the Place of Memory is to reconcile Peruvians who were separated due to conflict decades ago which should not repeat itself, well actually reconciliation hasn’t been achieved yet. It’s true that its origin comes from the fact that nobody agrees here – there is no agreement over history. Therefore, whatever story is told there, that is reality. What would have had to happen was some kind of consensus regarding history. From there already could come a consensus around how to tell that history and where to make it. On another hand, whether such space exists or doesn’t exist is little transcendent. Museums aren’t inviting places in our country. Beyond telling any particular version of events, people don’t go to museums! Those opposing the Place of Memory saying that a certain narrative won’t be told, right or wrong, perform absurd complaints taking into account that museum attendance is very low. Thus I believe the Place of Memory probably wouldn’t have much impact socially.
